data.one_liner: Applies separation of concerns to Flame game logic via Entities and Behaviors.
data.what_it_does: Flame Behaviors structures game logic by organizing components into Entities and Behaviors, originally built by Very Good Ventures. It helps cleanly separate game objects from their specific behavioral aspects.
use_when: You are building a game using the Flame engine and want better separation of concerns.
Your game objects require distinct, modular behavioral components.
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine.
Your game is simple enough that standard Flame components suffice without modular behavior separation.
strengths: Promotes clean separation of concerns for game logic using Entities and Behaviors.
Developed by Very Good Ventures with ongoing community support.
weaknesses: Requires learning a specific architectural pattern on top of Flame.
Adds an extra layer of abstraction to standard Flame components.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the flame package and setting the flame version constraints to '>=1.10.0 <2.0.0'.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer building your game directly with standard Flame components without the Entities and Behaviors abstraction layer.
